title: Recipe 01: Login and protected pages
titleZh: 方案01：登录与受保护页面
summary: An HttpOnly demo session protects invoice records. Expiring or signing out removes both the records and the declared actions.
summaryZh: HttpOnly 示例会话保护发票记录。会话过期或退出后，记录与已声明动作都会消失。

files.label: App.vue
files.roleZh: 会话界面与受保护声明

files.label: server.mjs
files.roleZh: HttpOnly 会话与受保护 API

guide.title: Keep identity outside the capability surface
guide.titleZh: 把身份留在能力面之外
intro: The page uses a real local HTTP session. No password, cookie, or token becomes an action parameter.
Sign in, then inspect the assistant. Expire the session and ask again; the protected records and tools are no longer declared.
introZh: 页面使用真实的本地 HTTP 会话。密码、Cookie 与 token 都不会成为动作参数。
登录后观察助手。让会话过期再问一次；受保护记录与工具都不再被声明。

steps.title: Create the page runtime
steps.body: The demo sets an explicit 100-turn limit and installs one Pling plugin.
steps.bodyZh: 示例显式设置 100 轮上限，并安装一个 Pling 插件。

steps.title: Declare protected records
steps.body: Records are rendered only inside the signed-in branch. The model cannot recover records the page did not project.
steps.bodyZh: 记录只在登录分支中渲染。页面没有投影的记录，模型也无法凭空取得。

steps.title: Gate the write tool
steps.body: The note tool is unavailable when signed out, and the API still rechecks the session on every request.
steps.bodyZh: 未登录时备注工具不可用；API 每次请求仍会重新检查会话。

guide.note: Local service: demo@example.com / pling-demo. Start it with pnpm dev:examples. The token and cookie are never model inputs.
guide.noteZh: 本地账号：demo@example.com / pling-demo。用 pnpm dev:examples 启动。token 与 Cookie 都不会成为模型输入。
